purpose: Evangel tokenless OSS Devnet funding pilot
scope: Exercise refundable test-SOL sponsorship, declared owner or contributor payroll, delivery review, challenges and failed-work reopening. No mainnet funds or token launch is authorized by these terms.
acceptance: The owner accepts these exact UTF-8 file bytes by signing requestAdoption with their SHA-256 digest. Publication and identity verification alone do not constitute acceptance or governance approval.
governance: Existing independent Squads 2-of-3 reviewers and the two-day quorum timelock apply. Approval begins an additional two-day adoption notice. Governance must recheck repository control and wallet binding.
funding: Tokenless adoption pays no upfront SOL. Sponsorships are refundable by their sponsor for 24 hours; only settled funds may be committed. The current pilot caps are 10 SOL lifetime repository funding and 1 SOL per payroll milestone.
work: Plans require objective acceptance criteria, budget, deadline, evidence and declared recipient conflicts. Plan approval does not authorize payment. Completion, challenges and failed-work reopening follow deployed custody rules. Failed work retains its allocation for another eligible community worker.
limitations: Devnet only. The deployed binary retains the published pending-adoption contention finding until a separately reviewed governance upgrade. These terms do not modify protocol rules or promise compensation.
